diagnosis.c1Hypothesis: Removing the repository OCIO override would restore AgX and Medium High Contrast in Blender 5.2.
diagnosis.finding: A clean environment and factory startup still reject Medium High Contrast. Blender 5.x bundled color management uses ACES 2.0 as its native photoreal view transform; the base D6 AgX look pair is not a legal Blender 5.2 native selection.
diagnosis.boundary: The second failure occurred before the first render call; no validation pixel or validation geometry was observed.

authorizedChanges.auditor: Bind C2 and immutable v0.2, treat C2 replacementColorContract as the expected view transform and look, bind the changed renderer hash through admission, and use the fresh retry root.
